name: gpt-image
description: Sessions draw pictures on your ChatGPT subscription, no API key and no extra payment: from a description and up to 16 references, the result lands straight in the project folder. Descriptions and references go to OpenAI
why: A session hands over a finished picture, not just a description for one

ru.why: Сессия отдаёт готовую картинку, а не только описание для неё
